operators.name: convt1d_bias_round

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided; custom op should handle strides

semantics: Performs ConvTranspose1d with bias=None (explicitly ignores any module bias), stride, padding, output_padding as integers.
Adds each param tensor (shape [out_channels]) to the conv output via broadcasting over batch and length dimensions (equivalent to x + param.view(1, -1, 1) repeated for each param).
The order of additions is sequential as in reference, but the final result is equivalent to summing all params before adding.
Input and output tensors are on CUDA; all parameters are on CUDA at execution time.

reference_steps.source: x = F.conv_transpose1d(x, self.conv_transpose.weight, bias=None, stride=self.conv_transpose.stride, padding=self.conv_transpose.padding, output_padding=self.conv_transpose.output_padding)
semantics: Uses weight of shape [in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size].
Output spatial length = (in_length - 1)*stride - 2*padding + dilation*(kernel_size-1) + output_padding + 1, with dilation=1.

reference_steps.source: for param in self.params: x = x + param.view(1, -1, 1)
semantics: Sequentially adds each parameter tensor (shape [out_channels]) to the output, broadcasting over batch and length dimensions.
Effectively adds the sum of all param tensors once.
Applies elementwise rounding to nearest integer (ties to even).
Returns the rounded tensor of shape [batch, out_channels, out_length] on CUDA.
